newsitem.title: USA: Swissray files to market X-ray system.
newsitem.headline: Swissray files to market X-ray system.

text.p: Swissray International Inc said on Monday it had filed a 510 (K) application with the United States Food and Drug Administration to obtain marketing clearance for its digital X-ray image system.
The company said in a statement that the system, the Digital Add-On Bucky, is a digital X-ray image acquisition system which produces direct, filmless digitization of X-ray images.
"The Add-On Bucky is designed to enhance and digitize X-ray images in conjunction with virtually all existing medical diagnostic X-ray equipment," the company said.

Ruedi G. Laupper, president of Swissray, said, "The filing of the 510 (K) will provide entry into the U.S. market which represents a significant step in the product development of our digital Add-On Bucky.
Swissray International Inc, with principal offices in Hitzkirch, Switzerland, is a developer of X-ray technology and systems.
